title: Associativity of componentwise XOR
statement:
For all $x, y, z \in \{0,1\}^n$, the componentwise XOR is associative: writing $x \oplus y$ for the vector with $i$th coordinate $x_i \oplus y_i$,
\[
(x \oplus y) \oplus z = x \oplus (y \oplus z).
\]
hypotheses_covered: x, y, z are vectors in the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
replaced:
For all $x, y, z \in \{0,1\}^n$, coordinate-wise XOR is associative:
$(x \oplus y) \oplus z = x \oplus (y \oplus z)$.
